post_clip.description: A person exits the driver's side of a parked black car with the door open, then another individual runs rapidly from the background gate toward the car and approaches the first person near the open door. The second person’s hurried approach and proximity to the car with an open door suggest potential unauthorized interaction or attempted theft/assault; no collision occurs, but the behavior is suspicious and deviates from normal parking/unloading activity.

Two individuals engage in a physical altercation near the left side of the driveway: one person (dark clothing) runs toward another (lighter top), they grapple, and one is pushed or falls to the ground near a covered object. A third person (woman in dark top and light shorts) observes and moves closer, appearing concerned. This constitutes suspicious/violent activity (assault/fighting) inconsistent with normal residential behavior.
